messages:
ana: Heads-up: On 2026-06-02 02:00 UTC well migrate our legacy GitLab issue backlog + CI webhook integrations into GitHub. This is a combined data + auth cutover: issue imports, label remapping, webhook endpoint updates, and SCIM/SSO sync adjustments. Expected short interruption to issue creation and inbound webhooks (~5-10m).

jules: TL;DR: import GitLab projects to matching GitHub repos, map labels/milestones, update any automation that posts to the old GitLab webhooks, and re-sync SCIM group mappings so permissions match. Dry-run in staging 2026-06-01 23:00 UTC.

matt: ack. What happens to cross-repo references and issue permalinks?

ana: We will preserve issue bodies and internal references where possible; permalinks (gitlab.com/...) will have redirect notices in the migration report but not automatic redirects on external sites. Public permalinks change, so update any docs/KB that link to GitLab issues. We will include a CSV mapping old_issue_id -> new_issue_url in the ticket PLAT-12121.

idp-bot: Note: SSO session claim `groups` will be restructured during the sync so some users may need to re-login. SCIM sync will reassign a few infra groups to GitHub teams. If you depend on group slugs in CI, check them after 02:10 UTC.

ana: (typo) sorry meant ana. Who should update webhooks for integrations (e.g., PagerDuty, release-bot)?

jules: Owners of integrations: update endpoints that point to `gitlab.redwood.internal/hooks/*` to `github.redwood.internal/hooks/*`. We'll run an automated proxy that rewrites payloads for the first 12h post-cutover for popular integrations, but please migrate your apps as soon as possible.

matt: Any CI impacts? Our GitLab pipelines trigger deploys and call internal APIs with tokens.

jules: During cutover we'll pause inbound pipeline triggers for 5-10m while we switch webhook routing. Existing in-flight pipeline jobs continue; new triggers will be accepted by GitHub actions/Workflows post cutover. If your deploys rely on `CI_JOB_TOKEN` semantics on GitLab, migrate to our `CI_TOKEN` issued by tokens.redwood.internal (see PLAT-12121 for mapping).

infra-bot: Quick scans to find GitLab references:
```bash
rg "gitlab" --hidden -n || true
rg "gitlab.redwood.internal" -S || true
```

ana: Who is the rollback contact if imports look wrong?

jules: Rollback is: disable the GitHub repo imports and re-open read-only access to the GitLab projects (we snapshot everything pre-cutover). We'll rollback if more than 3% of imported issues have missing required fields or if >100 automation failures across critical integrations. Escalate to @matt and @devops.

matt: Commands to preview mapping?

jules: Use the migration tool in `platform/tools/gitlab-importer`:
```bash
# preview mapping (dry-run)
python tools/gitlab_importer.py --source gitlab.redwood.internal --project infra/launcher --dry-run --output mapping.json
```
Open mapping.json to see label changes, milestone mapping, and any unresolved references.

ana: What about labels and milestone name collisions?

jules: We will apply a deterministic remapping: prefix GitLab labels with `gl-` if theres a collision. Milestones are matched by title then date; if ambiguous we will create a `gl-` prefixed milestone and log it for manual reconciliation.

idp-bot: SCIM sync dry-run started 2026-06-01 23:05 UTC. No permission gaps detected in staging.

infra-bot: Dry-run import in staging completed at 23:45 UTC. Sample of 3 projects imported successfully; flagged 7 issues with unresolved references (due to private snippets) for manual review.

matt: During the live window, who do we ping for webhook failures?

jules: Ping @devops first. We will also enable a proxy shim that posts failure details to this channel. The runbook has a `replay-webhook.sh` script to re-send payloads to the new endpoint.

devops: Live cutover timeline: 02:00 UTC start, 02:05 UTC begin webhook switch, 02:08 UTC start imports (parallel), 02:20 UTC verification window. We'll keep GitLab read-only for 24h after import for freeze + validation.

ana: Will CI tokens be rotated?

jules: Yes. All tokens used by GitLab runners will be rotated. We will issue new `CI_TOKEN` secrets in Vault under `secret/ci/<project>` and update actions templates. If you have hard-coded values, please swap them out before 2026-06-02 01:00 UTC.

infra-bot: Live cutover started at 02:00:12 UTC. Starting webhook proxy flip and project imports.

infra-bot: Webhook proxy updated at 02:05:03 UTC. Incoming webhooks now routed to github.redwood.internal; proxy running in translation-mode (rewrites GitLab payloads for GitHub apps).

infra-bot: Import batch 1 completed at 02:12:47 UTC. 27 projects imported, 12 issues flagged for manual review.

devops: Observed 4 webhook retries for PagerDuty integration due to missing `issue_url` field in the translated payloads. Manually replayed them using `scripts/replay-webhook.sh` and updated mapping for PagerDuty.

idp-bot: SCIM sync applied at 02:18:30 UTC. Team membership counts validated. Two infra groups needed manual mapping; owners notified.

matt: Spot-checking deployed services: token exchange OK for sample deploys. No auth regressions observed.

jules: We will keep the GitLab read-only snapshot for 48h before full archive. Any manual reconciliation requests, open PLAT-12121 with `reconcile:<project>` tag.

ana: Thanks team, I updated internal docs and replaced 3 webhook endpoints for ops-bots.

devops: Final import batch done at 02:25:59 UTC. Total 84 projects, 12 flagged issues, 3 integration tweaks. Cutover looks green.

jules: Closing: mapping CSV and migration log attached to PLAT-12121. If you find missing references or permission issues, post the old GitLab id + repo here and we'll triage.

ana: great work everyone. :rocket:
